brief_rationale: The doctor systematically clarified the episode as right-eye cataract surgery, screened for red flags, locked the discharge eye drop (levofloxacin/可乐必妥) to the operated right eye, distinguished preoperative from discharge medications, and built a concrete family execution plan with labeling and a check-off system that adapts to rotating caregivers. A minor responsibility-chain error exists: RC7 (diabetes/hypertension boundary) was only partially satisfied because the doctor did not explicitly state that chronic disease medications should not be self-stopped due to eye surgery – the advice focuses on routine monitoring and confirmatory steps but does not clearly prevent the “停药” risk. This minor/moderate error caps the grade at 2 (borderline). No serious error is present.
